Remove all the workers completely and remove the pale cloud in the pit. Their work stays as objects: the great treadwheel stands empty, a harness on its rail, rope and shoulder straps coiled by the stacks, levers set under a block. The towering element, dominating the picture: a tall tower of pale cut stone in four stepped tiers stands in the middle of the pit and rises far above the cliff crest, with timber scaffolds on its sides. On its top stands a giant treadwheel crane of black oak, its long jib holding on thick iron chains one enormous raw rough block, three times taller than the wheel, hanging high in the sky above the quarry.
